scope: full dev, own token-bounded passages; not published-baseline reproduction

metric_definitions.hit_at_5: at least one annotated positive in top-5
metric_definitions.gold_recall_at_5: fraction of all annotated gold chunks retrieved in top-5, macro over queries
metric_definitions.mrr_at_10: reciprocal rank of first positive within top-10

latency_ms.scope: retrieval of prepared query only; one query per sample; warm BM25 index
latency_ms.note: development run on a shared machine; not an isolated hardware or end-to-end benchmark

unmapped_policy: undefined gold queries excluded from that relevance metric and counted explicitly
